product_summary: KTA Spindle Toolings LLP (Pune, Hinjewadi Phase-II; GSTIN 27ABCFK4625Q1ZU as printed on site) describes itself as a precision tool-holder manufacturer and exporter, 30+ years in tapping chucks/tap adaptors and 15+ years in tool holders, capacity stated as 10,000 holders/month, ISO-9001, and states 60% of production is exported. Actual product lines listed on ktaspindletoolings.com/about and /products: (1) ER collet chucks; (2) Weldon / side-lock holders; (3) shrink-fit holders; (4) hydraulic expansion chucks and reduction sleeves; (5) power milling chucks; (6) die & mould chucks; (7) face mill holders; (8) combi shell mill holders; (9) tapping chucks for synchronised tapping (MLC); (10) quick-change tapping chucks KWFLK 1-4 with safety-clutch tap adaptors; plus quick-change drilling & tapping chucks, rigid tapping chucks, floating reamer holders, wheel arbors, hydraulic chucks. Standards: BT30/40/50 (MAS-403 / DIN ISO 7388-2), SK40/50 (DIN 69871 / ISO 7388-1), HSK-A50/63/100 (DIN 69893-1), HSK-F63 (DIN 69893-6), CAT40/50 (ANSI B5.50). Also acts as India partner of HPCHO GmbH, Germany.
role_hint: manufacturer (own production stated, Pune works; also distributes German HPCHO line — manufacturer_trader element possible but not proven)
comment: HS mapping: the declared 846610 is the correct and dominant heading — exact match for the entire tool-holder / chuck / tap-adaptor range. 732690 is plausible only for steel bodies/blank components and is not evidenced by any catalogue line — заявлено, не подтверждено. 820411 (non-adjustable hand-operated spanners/wrenches) is WRONG: no wrench or hand tool appears anywhere in the catalogue; the closest real items are tap adaptors and quick-change chucks, which belong to 8466/8207, not 8204. 730799 (iron/steel tube or pipe fittings) is WRONG and looks like a mis-keyed code — no pipe, tube, flange or fitting product exists on the site; likely a confusion with 7307 vs 8466/8207. Recommended correction: 846610 (primary) + 846693 + 820790, with 732690 only if steel blanks are actually shipped. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a machine-tool / metalworking accessories maker (CNC tooling), i.e. mechanical engineering / machine tools — no oil & gas or chemical product line exists. Trader signs: site markets itself as manufacturer with own works address and capacity, but also carries the HPCHO Germany brand and a 'Distributor Login' / 'Download Distributor Application Form' section, so a trading/distribution component is present alongside manufacturing. Product lines missing from the declaration: tapping chucks and tap adaptors (the company's oldest and largest line), hydraulic expansion chucks, shrink-fit chucks, wheel arbors, reduction sleeves, floating reamer holders — all of which fall under 8466/8207 and are absent from the declared codes. All product statements above are from the company's own website (ktaspindletoolings.com/about, /products) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (out of scope), so no shipment-level corroboration is asserted. Note: site itself warns of 'minor discrepancies in item codes' during a catalogue re-coding exercise, which supports the likelihood of the declared HS codes being stale/mis-keyed.
